sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and setup
sections.what: Loads the libraries, icons, data types, store, and form pieces that the pop-up needs. It also marks the file as a browser component.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The top-of-file marker is typical for components that run in the browser.

sections.name: AssignmentModalProps
sections.title: Pop-up inputs
sections.what: Defines the values the parent screen must give the pop-up: whether it is open, how to close it, and an optional assignment to edit.
sections.why: Lets one form be reused for both adding and editing.

sections.name: AssignmentModal (part 1)
sections.title: Starting values for the form
sections.what: Fills each field with the existing assignment's value, or a default such as 20% weight, 23:59 deadline, or today's date for new assignments. The first course in the list is preselected when there is no existing assignment.
sections.why: Gives the owner a usable form right away and lets editing show the current values.
sections.watch_out: These values are read only when the pop-up first loads, so reopening it for another assignment can show old text.

sections.name: AssignmentModal (part 2)
sections.title: Save and close
sections.what: When the form is submitted, it stops the page from reloading, skips the save if the title is blank, and saves either an update or a new assignment. Numbers that are not valid fall back to defaults. Then the pop-up closes.
sections.why: Separates editing from creating so existing records are not duplicated.
sections.watch_out: Only the title is checked, and a weight of 0 becomes 10 because of the fallback.

sections.name: AssignmentModal (part 3)
sections.title: Form fields for course, priority, and dates
sections.what: Shows the labeled inputs for title, course code dropdown, subject, professor, priority dropdown, deadline date, deadline time and weight. Changes update the screen's remembered values.
sections.why: Gives the owner a clear place to enter each detail.

sections.name: AssignmentModal (part 4)
sections.title: Link, notes and buttons
sections.what: Shows the submission link input, the execution notes textarea, and Cancel and submit buttons. The submit label reads Update Assignment when editing and Add Assignment otherwise.
sections.why: Finishes the form with the last free-text fields and the actions.
sections.watch_out: Cancel only calls onClose, so any typed text is discarded without a confirmation.

summary: A pop-up form for adding a new course assignment or editing an existing one, which saves the details to the app's central store.
purpose: Lets the owner record an assignment's title, course, deadline, priority, status, weight, progress, submission link and notes.
why: Keeps all assignment entry in one reusable form, so the same screen serves both 'add' and 'edit'.
how: The form fields start with the existing assignment's values, or sensible defaults if none exist. When the owner presses save, the form trims the text, converts numbers, and sends the result either to the store's update or add action. Then it closes the pop-up. Nothing is shown if the form is closed.
inputs: Whether the pop-up is open, a function that closes it, and an optional existing assignment to edit. The owner's typed values and the list of courses from the store.
outputs: Calls to add or update an assignment in the store, and a call to close the pop-up. Nothing is returned to other code.
risks: Only the title is checked before saving, so a wrong deadline, weight or progress value is accepted silently. The form's values are set once when the pop-up first loads, so reopening it for a different assignment may show stale text unless the parent remounts it. A weight of 0 is saved as 10 because of how the code falls back to a default.
debug: If saved values look wrong, check the store actions named in the save step and the defaults used when a field is empty. If editing shows old values, check whether the parent component is reusing this pop-up without remounting it. If nothing saves, confirm the title is not blank.
